assessment: This study is directed at cardiac fibrotic change, which is widespread both under conditions of both normal development and pathological responses, and it is associated with both pump failure and arrhythmic change. A new genetic platform is introduced, in which such processes are reduced. What emerges is a reduction in ventricular, atrial and septal fibroblast density. This study is extremely well done, rigorous, and offers valuable insight for investigators interested in fibrosis, cardiac fibroblast biology, and mechanisms of extracellular matrix remodeling.
